What we can show you, and what we won't claim.
1
How we choose a form
We pick the ingredient form for each product and name it on the label, so you can compare it with anything else on the shelf.
Where a form needs particular directions, such as iron on an empty stomach, or D3 and K2 with food, those directions are on the bottle.
2
How products are made

Each product is made in a GMP-certified facility in Gujarat by a manufacturer we name on the label: Asoj Soft Caps (Baroda), Vebe Lifecare (Baroda) and U-Liva Nutrition (Rajkot).

3
How products are checked

Every product carries the third-party tested mark on its label, and every bottle has a code that leads to more about what is inside.
Test reports and certificates are not published on this site yet.

4
How amounts are reported
Each active ingredient has its own amount per serving.
Where a recommended daily allowance exists, the %RDA follows ICMR 2020 guidelines and the label says which reference group it uses.
Where ingredients come from
HOW IT WORKS
01
Ingredient origin

Where the raw ingredient is grown, harvested or first produced.

Not yet published

02
Processing location

Where the ingredient is purified or converted into the form named on the label.

Not yet published

03
Finished-product manufacturer

The facility that blends, fills and packs the product you buy.

Named on every label

WHAT YOU CAN CHECK
When these details are confirmed, each product will list all three separately.
A single line that merges them can't tell you which step happened where.

CURRENT STATUS

Every label names the finished-product manufacturer and its licence number, and both are shown on every product page. Ingredient origins, processing locations and suppliers haven't been published yet. We don't name a source we can't confirm.

How quality is checked
QUESTIONS A QUALITY PROCESS SHOULD ANSWER
01
When ingredients arrive

What is checked before an ingredient is used, and by whom?

02
During manufacture

Which controls confirm the right ingredient goes in, in the right amount?

03
Before release

What is checked on the finished product, and against which specification?

04
Over shelf life

How is it confirmed that the product still matches its label by the date on the pack?

CURRENT STATUS

Our documented quality process hasn't been published. Until it is, we don't describe any check as completed, and we don't name a laboratory or quality partner.

The evidence behind the standard
WHAT DOES EACH KIND OF EVIDENCE PROVE?
What each kind of evidence checks, covers and can't tell you
KIND OF EVIDENCE	WHAT IT CHECKS	WHAT IT COVERS	WHAT IT CAN'T TELL YOU	WHERE TO VERIFY IT	BODY CAFÉ CO. TODAY
Ingredient research	What studies have found about an ingredient, usually in a particular form and amount.	The ingredient as studied, not a particular product.	What's in a specific bottle, or how a product will work for you.	The study itself, or an independent summary such as an NIH fact sheet.	
PUBLISHED
Cited as background in our guides. Not used as product claims.
Finished-product testing	Whether a sample of the finished product meets its specification, using stated methods.	The sample and lot that were tested.	Other lots, an individual pack, or a health outcome.	The report: laboratory, method, result with units, limit and date.	
NOT YET PUBLISHED
Labels state “third-party tested”. No results published.
Certification	That an independent body assessed something against its own standard.	Exactly what the certificate names: a facility, a process or a product.	Anything outside that named scope.	The certifier's own public listing, not the brand's page.	
NOT YET PUBLISHED
Labels state “GMP certified”. Certificate not yet published.
Lot report	The records for one manufacturing lot, gathered in one place.	One lot, through the sample tested from it.	Whether a single pack is genuine, or how it will work for you.	Our lot lookup, using the number printed on your pack.	
NOT YET PUBLISHED
Lot records are added as they are published.
THE DOCUMENT LIBRARY

No documents have been published yet. When one is, it will appear here with each of these details.

WHAT EVERY DOCUMENT WILL NAME
Product and lot
Which product, and which lot, the document describes.
Source
Who issued it.
Date and version
When it was issued, and whether it replaces an earlier version.
Scope
What it covers, and what it doesn't.
Verification
Where to confirm it independently, when that's possible.

CURRENT STATUS

No test reports, certificates or laboratory documents have been published. Ingredient research is cited only as background in Learn, with its sources linked.

Good questions about our standards
Where do your ingredients come from?
Our finished-product manufacturers are named on every product page.
Ingredient origin and processing records are not published yet; those stages remain separate from final manufacture.
Are your products tested?
No test results or laboratory documents have been published, so we don't describe any product as tested.
When a report is published, it will be linked to the lot it describes.
Do you hold any certifications?
Our labels state “GMP certified”.
The certificate itself isn't published on this site yet.
When it is, it will appear with exactly what it covers, a facility, a process or a product, and a link to the certifier's own listing.
Is an FSSAI licence a quality certification?
No. An FSSAI licence or registration is what a food business needs to operate in India.
It isn't a test of a particular product's quality.
What about allergens and dietary needs?
Allergen statements come from approved labels, which haven't been published yet.
Omega-3 Fish Oil comes from fish, and capsule and softgel materials aren't confirmed.
Vitamin D3 + K2 includes omega-3 as triglycerides; its source will be stated on the approved label.
Does a lot report prove my bottle is genuine?
No. A report describes a sample from one lot.
Checking an individual pack would need a separate unit code, and that hasn't been decided.
Why isn't a document available yet?
Because it hasn't been supplied in a version we can publish.
We'd rather show a clear status than a placeholder badge.
You can ask about a specific product or lot at any time.

Still unsure? Visit the help centre or ask us directly.
